[b]Choosing the target[/b]
With Valddera's civil war in full swing a debate started within high command which territory is first: the Thalassia Islands or the mainland itself. This schism delayed the goverment's response and soon the prime minister had to intervene. 2 plans were laid out before him.
Plan 1: Recognizing the importance of the Thalassia islands this plan wants to ship 6000-7000 marines with HVLMS Vespurië to the islands to force the terrorists out while Vespurië provides coastal bombardment to cover the marines on the beach. Although good in practice and theory the news of Hydronia also intervening caused a few naval officers to immediately design another plan thinking that the Hydronians can also take the Thalassia islands since they are closer to them.
Plan 2: This plan involves a full naval invasion of Valddera's coast that is occupied by the terrorists. The landing would involve 10000 Marines and several ships in the first phase with 2500 soldiers from the ground army shipped to Valddera if the landing succeeds in the second phase with the goal of advancing to the nearby towns and cities once landing succeeds. Other officers against it stated that some cities on the southern coast weren't worth it and that instead the navy should focus on the Thalassia islands.
Now the prime minister looks over both plans. He starts to think that the Thalassia islands can be handled by countries closer to Valddera and decides that it will be plan 2.

Preparations are now underway[/spoiler]
